tail_protocol: Native unnormalized stereo power mean. Hann periodogram on0.2–0.4s early and1.4–1.6s held late,32,768FFT,48kHz. Harmonic h1..h12 integrates fixed nominal h*f0 ±max(10Hz,2%h*f0); late upper ratio sumsH8..H12/H1. Four3-second successive notes retain normal engine release state. Ratios are descriptors, not tone acceptance. The scalar calibration cancels in relative partial ratios.

late_partial_comparison.scope: Every row aggregates twelve shape/wood constructions; candidate minus Before. Allrows are descriptive native signal measurements.

mixed_string_G3_boundary.protocol: G3/G minus mean Fsharp3/D and Gsharp3/G heldRMS. Sequential review performance; this includes a change of physical string.

native_capture_level_factors.scope: Construction reference and capture trim product; other fitted/capture factors are unchanged. Float32 table entries; dB deltas show scalar native reference changes after physical candidate calibration.

completed_native_phrase_check.policy_note: Some hardest Pick cases still fall short of the 1 dB headroom goal. Existing policy passes because they have surrendered the allowed 0.9LU level; no new headroom/loudness waiver.

limitations: D string pluck direction is retained; scalar calibration changes its native output level but not its relative upper-partial balance.
G receives a partial direction change and retains uneven tails by note/construction, including existing local prominence.
The immutable physical-string profile avoids the rejected pitch ramp Dsharp4 attack amplification. It is an authored gauge proxy, not a measured pluck angle.
Higher-string native ratios and passing loudness/chord checks do not establish a listener preference.
